meta.title: Stays in Dahab
meta.description: Hotels, chalets and camps in Dahab — book a stay on its own, or turn it into a full trip with WEEMAP transport.

hero.title: A place in Dahab that actually feels like Dahab.
hero.lede: Camps on the sea, quiet chalets, proper hotels — curated, not crawled. Book the stay alone, or build a whole trip around it.
